clean_null_not_flagged.principle: a null WITH a passed positive control is NOT flagged -- guards against over-firing (a valid null stays valid).

guard_mechanism.principle: names the guard + where it fires -- the fix that stops a broken positive control being read as a clean efficiency null.

honest_verdict.principle: terminal prefix; shipped: positive_control_failed_guard_added OR complete: positive_control_failed_guard_partial_<reason>.

inference_substrate.principle: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates -- runs the guard against fixtures, no model load (1s floor).

preconditions_checked.principle: records resources verified; pre-empts missing-resource fabrication.

tests_added_pass.principle: Tests Must Run and Assert -- both the fires-on-broken and clean-on-passed cases.

trap_exemplar_flagged.principle: whether the exp4544 fixture (positive_control_passed=False) is correctly classified false_negative_risk_open -- the concrete bug this catches.

assertions: exp4544 positive-control-failed efficiency null fires false_negative_risk_open
matched passed-positive-control null does not fire
capstone excludes false_negative_risk_open from headline aggregation
